听到这里，江辰心头那叫一个美汁美汁～

“啥情况，这臭泥怎么也发朋友圈了？！”

出租屋内，丸子、香菜嘴巴张大，死死盯着手机屏幕。

一脸的难以置信！

只见，微信好友赵安妮刚发的朋友圈动态照片里，除了美味大烤鱼外，还有烤鸡、各类烧烤、水果拼盘......

用一个词来形容，那就是——

豪华大餐！

而她的文案内容则是这样写着：

【感谢江先生深夜送来温暖，充满爱的宵夜，比心比心！】

江先生？

爱的宵夜？

丸子、香菜几乎同一时间，目光直直锁定了旁边的江辰。

江辰身体一凛，顿时有股被逮个正着的心虚。

“哥，该不会是你偷偷给臭泥点的宵夜吧？”丸子眯着眼，质问道。

江辰一脸淡定，起身，伸了个懒腰：

“嗯，我点的。”

“为什么？”

“难不成，你想跟她发生点什么？”丸子满腹狐疑地看着江辰。

江辰干咳了一下，一本正经解释道：

“你们知道的，你哥我向来喜欢助人为乐，尤其在资助贫困少女这件事上……”

然而，他话音未落，丸子手上的一个小熊枕头，就跟迫击炮似的。

精准无误地砸在了他的脑袋上。

“哥！你老实交代，你是不是看上那个狐狸精了？”

看着丸子那副质问的表情，江辰眉头轻轻一皱。

丸子这小妮子，该不会是吃醋了吧？

就在这时，空气中传来啃鸡腿时“嘎嘣脆”的声响。

丸子低头一看，旋即恨铁不成钢地道：

“香菜，你怎么还有心情吃啊！哥，都要红杏出墙了！”

一边看戏，一边吃香辣鸡腿的香菜，神色不由一愣。

随后，她放下手中鸡腿，义愤填膺地站了起来。

“哥，你怎么能那么贪心呢？有我和丸子姐还不够，居然还要……红杏出墙！！”

说到最后，她更是一脸委屈巴巴起来。

那样子，就像是她男人在外面偷偷找了别的女人。

江辰语塞。

心中暗道：额……我读书少，但，红杏出墙不是这么用的吧？

“咚咚！”

门外突然响起了敲门声。

之前下单的肯德基外卖到了。

江辰适时前去开门。

随后提着两大袋全家桶，走到二女面前。

拆开包装，取出香辣鸡腿，递到丸子嘴边，柔声道：

“趁热，快吃吧。”

丸子张口就咬，一脸满足地对江辰说道：

“哥，你喂的鸡腿太好吃了！我还要～”

俏脸浮现出甜美的笑容，和方才咄咄逼人的样子，简直判若两人。

见此，江辰心中默默撰写心得：对付丸子这类女生，还是得用吃的，才能堵住她的嘴！

见此一幕，香菜的声音也变得有些娇里娇气，“哼呐，我也要哥投喂～”

“好好好！”

财神爷的要求，江辰自然是要给予满足。

一夜无话。

时间，飞快流逝。

第二天，金黄色的太阳光沿着窗户射入屋内。

两个精神小妹一改往日的作息，早已起来刷牙洗漱。

丸子是有些厨艺傍身的。

家境不好，打小她就学会了如何“下得厨房”。

Hearing this, Jiang Chen's heart felt so delicious~

"What's going on? Why is this stinky mud posted on WeChat Moments?!"

In the rental house, Wanzi and Xiangcai stared at their mobile screens with their mouths wide open.

A look of disbelief!

I saw that in the dynamic photo that WeChat friend Zhao Anni just posted in the circle of friends, in addition to delicious grilled fish, there are also grilled chicken, various barbecues, fruit platters...

To describe it in one word, that is——

Luxurious meal!

The content of her copy reads:

[Thank you Mr. Jiang for sending you a warm and loving late-night snack late at night. Thank you!】

Mr. Jiang?

Love’s late night snack?

Wanzi and Xiangcai locked their eyes on Jiang Chen next to them almost at the same time.

Jiang Chen's body trembled, and he suddenly felt guilty about being caught red-handed.

"Brother, could it be that you secretly ordered some late-night snacks for Xianni?" Wanzi narrowed his eyes and asked.

Jiang Chen looked calm, stood up, and stretched:

"Yeah, I ordered it."

"Why?"

"Is it possible that you want to have something happen with her?" Wanzi looked at Jiang Chen suspiciously.

Jiang Chen coughed dryly and explained seriously:

"As you know, your brother and I have always liked to help others, especially when it comes to supporting poor girls..."

However, before he finished speaking, Wanzi held a bear pillow in his hand, like a mortar.

It hit him on the head with perfect accuracy.

"Brother! Tell me honestly, have you fallen in love with that vixen?"

Seeing Wanzi's questioning expression, Jiang Chen frowned slightly.

This little girl, Wan Zi, must be jealous, right?

At this moment, the sound of "crunching" when gnawing on chicken legs could be heard in the air.

Wanzi lowered his head and looked at it, and immediately said:

"Xiancai, why are you still in the mood to eat! Brother, Hongxing is going to cheat on you!"

While watching the show, I was eating spicy chicken drumsticks with cilantro, and I couldn't help but feel stunned.

Then she put down the drumstick in her hand and stood up angrily.

"Brother, how can you be so greedy? It's not enough to have Sister Wanzi and me, you actually want... Hongxing to cheat!!"

At the end of the sentence, she looked even more aggrieved.

It looked like her man was secretly looking for another woman outside.

Jiang Chen was speechless.

I thought to myself: Well...I don't know much about reading, but that's not how Hongxing cheats, right?

"Boom!"

There was a sudden knock on the door.

The KFC takeaway I ordered earlier has arrived.

Jiang Chen went to open the door at the right time.

Then he walked up to the two girls carrying two large bags of family buckets.

He opened the package, took out the spicy chicken drumsticks, handed it to Wanzi's mouth, and said softly:

"Eat it while it's hot."

He opened his mouth to bite the ball, and said to Jiang Chen with a satisfied look on his face:

"Brother, the chicken legs you feed are so delicious! I want more~"

A sweet smile appeared on her pretty face, which was completely different from the aggressive look just now.

Seeing this, Jiang Chen silently wrote his thoughts in his mind: To deal with girls like Wanzi, you still have to use food to stop her mouth!

Seeing this scene, Xiangcai's voice became a little squeamish, "Humph, I want my brother to feed me too~"

"Okay, okay!"

Jiang Chen naturally wanted to satisfy the God of Wealth's request.

A night of silence.

Time flies by.

The next day, golden sunlight streamed into the house along the windows.

The two spirited girls changed their usual schedule and got up early to brush their teeth and wash themselves.

Meatballs come with some cooking skills.

Her family was not well off, so she learned how to "become a master in the kitchen" since she was a child.
